features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 CON; +2 INT; -2 WIS.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; no size-based adjustments.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with garlean subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common. High-Intelligence options: Elvaan, Galkan, Goblin, Lalafellan, Mithran.

features.name: Fearless
features.description: +2 racial saves against fear effects.

features.name: Hardy
features.description: +2 racial saving throws against poison, spells and spell-like abilities.

features.name: Magitek Training
features.description: +4 dodge AC when opposed by robot-subtype constructs or magitek enemies.

condition.description: Against robot subtype constructs and magiteks

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception checks.

features.name: Noble Upbringing
features.description: +2 bonus to Knowledge (nobility) and Knowledge (history); both become class skills.

features.name: Sovereignty of The Nation
features.description: Select Firearms (Simple) proficiency OR a single specific Gun Arm Exotic Weapon Proficiency. No mass grant.

features.name: Technologically Advanced
features.description: +2 racial Knowledge (Technology), +2 Repair, and +2 ONE chosen technology-related Craft skill.

features.name: Third Eye
features.description: At will use detect magic as a spell-like ability; third eye opens and glows; caster level equals Garlean class level according to source wording, not total character level. Source labels Su despite calling it spell-like.

effects.textValue: At will; caster level = Garlean class level; check Su/Sp label discrepancy

features.name: Magic Ineptitude
features.description: Cannot gain an MP pool or activate spell-trigger, spell-completion, command-word, or use-activated magic items. Exceptions: alchemical items; activating/deactivating magic weapon/armor; benefiting from static wondrous/ring bonuses.

effects.textValue: Cannot obtain magic pool; listed magic item activation restrictions and explicit exceptions

features.name: Before Their Time
features.description: Technologist bonus feat; +2 racial Craft (Mechanical), +2 Repair. Replaces Technologically Advanced.

features.name: Engineer
features.description: +2 racial Craft (alchemy) and Knowledge (engineering). Replaces Noble Upbringing.

features.name: Magic Resistant
features.description: Spell resistance appears as "1 1 + character level" in retrieved live text; value requires visual/source verification; can voluntarily lower resistance for one round as standard action. Replaces Hardy AND Third Eye.

effects.textValue: Source text displays 1 1 + character level; parse unresolved pending verification; standard action to lower SR for 1 round

features.name: Magic User
features.description: May acquire MP pool and use spell-trigger, spell-completion, command-word and use-activated items. Replaces Hardy, Keen Senses AND Magic Ineptitude; removes all listed restrictions rather than layering over them.

effects.textValue: Lift restrictions formerly from Magic Ineptitude; normal class eligibility/MP rules still apply

features.name: Master Tinker
features.description: +2 bonus Disable Device and Knowledge (engineering). Replaces Noble Upbringing.

features.name: Physically Inspired
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics, Climb and Swim checks. Replaces Technologically Advanced.

features.name: Wary
features.description: +2 racial Sense Motive and Bluff checks. Replaces Noble Upbringing.

features.name: Wright
features.description: +2 racial Drive and +2 Craft/Repair checks for constructing or fixing vehicles. Replaces Technologically Advanced.

features.name: Xenophobia Extremis
features.description: Ability penalty becomes −2 CHA INSTEAD OF −2 WIS (retain +2 CON,+2 INT), and no Intelligence-based bonus languages. Source says MODIFIES ability vector and languages; component update needed.

effects.textValue: +2 CON,+2 INT,-2 CHA; bonus languages from INT prohibited; modification not blind stacking

features.name: Heritage Baelsar Ability Scores
features.description: +2 STR; +2 WIS; -2 CHA; these replace, never stack with, original CON/INT/WIS adjustment.

features.name: Heritage Baelsar Alternate Ability
features.description: +4 dodge AC versus monstrous humanoids.

features.name: Heritage Galvus Ability Scores
features.description: +2 CON; +2 CHA; -2 INT; these replace, never stack with, original CON/INT/WIS adjustment.

features.description: +2 racial saving throws against death effects and energy drain.

features.name: Heritage Garlond Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX; +2 INT; -2 WIS; these replace, never stack with, original CON/INT/WIS adjustment.

features.name: Heritage Garlond Alternate Ability
features.description: +2 dodge AC and +2 Reflex saves against traps.
